issue.title: Pytest worker-token waiters starve: later scoped runs take freed tokens and a 4-token waiter times out after 45m

task_type_fields.impact:
Under sustained concurrent agent checks on athena, a scoped `just check` can
burn its whole 45-minute wait and exit 4 without running a single test, while
newer runs keep getting tokens. The same contention left sase-1pu.3's check
UNDETERMINED (its note #1). Agents lose a full verification cycle and must
rerun. Proposed by sase-1pt.2 (epic sase-1pt, note #1).
task_type_fields.repro:
`tests/_suite_gate_lease.py` `WorkerTokenLease.acquire` polls `_attempt` every
poll interval with no ticket or arrival order, and each successful attempt
"greedily grows through ceiling". A run that has been waiting cannot reserve
the next freed tokens, so later scoped runs that happen to poll first take them.

Evidence: `just check` ToolRun `43ddd1bdeb9d756471872ee0a7e2bbe5` (sase-1pt.2--1,
2026-10-29, `sase tool show` → `WORKERS pytest lease 0 of 4–4 · budget 4 ·
waited 45m · from scoped`, exit 4). Its stdout
(`~/.sase/tools/logs/43ddd1bdeb9d756471872ee0a7e2bbe5/stdout.log`) prints 89
"Waiting for a SASE pytest worker-token grant of 4 worker tokens" lines. The
holder set rotates while it waits: first pids 2157973 (5) + 2292927 (4), then
2292927 (4) + 2456902 (6), then 2456902 (6) + 3091634 (4, age 74 s when first
seen). pids 2456902 and 3091634 both arrived after this run started waiting and
were granted ahead of it. The run then fails with "Timed out waiting for a SASE
pytest worker-token grant of 4 worker tokens after 2700s".

Repro sketch: hold the pool at capacity with one lease; start waiter A
(floor 4); release and immediately start waiter B before A's next poll; B gets
the grant. A unit test with a fake clock/poll interval can show A starving.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1pt.2 (epic sase-1pt land triage): a scoped just check waited the full 2700s while runs that arrived later were granted tokens, wasting an agent verification cycle.

payload.description: Earlier suite-gate fix bounded wedged holders; this task is waiter fairness in the same lease code
Long foreground checks that cannot be handed off make a starved token wait block the agent turn
